refused_20261122.about: Five handwriting-qwen reader answers (Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct through Hugging Face, provider novita) that production refused on 2026-11-22 between 08:24Z and 09:04Z: the distinct answers of the twelve reader runs refused that day, each run's two attempts giving the same answer. The coordinator of the autonomy program read them from Logfire (spans 'chat Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct' inside failed 'invoke_agent literal_transcriber_handwriting_qwen' runs) and handed lane RB1 each answer's `lines`, `verbatim_text`, trace id and time; those four are held here as handed over. The response ids, tool call ids, token counts and the answers' other arguments were not handed over, so these entries are not whole recorded tool calls as the entries of `answers` are: tests build a tool call around the two fields.
